Two links are self $\Delta$-equivalent when they are transformed into each other by self delta moves and ambient isotopies, with all three strings in each move belonging to the same component. **Shibuya's conjecture.** Any boundary link is self $\Delta$-equivalent to the trivial link. This conjecture predicts that self Delta-equivalence detects no further obstruction for boundary links beyond their boundary-link structure; the supplied text gives no resolution.
